value: U.S. Department of Energy, Office of Energy Efficiency and Renewable Energy, Industrial Technologies Program (2006). Replace Pressure-Reducing Valves with Backpressure Turbogenerators. Energy Tips - Steam, Steam Tip Sheet #20, January 2006. DOE/GO-102006-2265 (revised from DOE/GO-102002-1476, January 2002).

Two-page tip sheet; page numbers are PDF pages (none printed). Loaded: turbogenerator equipment cost for 150 kW and 2,000 kW systems (the 2,000 kW value is an upper bound "less than $200/kW"), installed cost derived with the printed 75% installation factor, 20-yr minimum life. Other-values: applicability thresholds, isentropic and boiler efficiencies, fuel-only power cost, figure line labels (kW/Mlb-hr). No price year stated; sheet is a 2006 revision of a 2002 edition. Same cost text reappears in Steam Tip Sheet #22 (doe_2012_002).
